source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb, tigerWMS_Census2020 — layer 26 (Incorporated Places) and layer 20 (County Subdivisions, FUNCSTAT='A'); POP100 is the 2020 decennial count.
what_counts: Every general-purpose local government of 25000 people or more: all incorporated places, plus county subdivisions only in states whose law makes the town or township the general-purpose government outside incorporated places.
